about: Prompts for the simulated activation test (tools/trigger_sim.py). 'fire' = the geo-visibility skill should be chosen; 'no-fire' = it should not (another skill, or none, should handle it). The split was fixed before any run: the skill description may be tuned using 'dev' failures only; 'test' is the held-out estimate and must not be used to tune.
